hypothesis: Scope completion callbacks and their required flush/sync can perturb command submission, CPU costs and Present-wait distribution. Remove complete probes, never required completion flags, to test instrumentation sensitivity.
correctness: All four 61440-byte GPU history outputs must match the same independent seed920071 CPU oracle byte for byte.
Every frame sentinel must match logical frame, active count, N262144 and changed slots.

Keep all nine queries, index updates, history dispatch and two actual draw calls (262144 points and 54 overlay vertices). Retain prescribed real AssetBundle load/register/cancel/unregister/unload events.

Requested native samples must finish Ready with valid tick conversion and original source frame. Unrequested samples are NotRequested with milliseconds=-1, zero token/ticks/frequency; never fabricated zero-duration measurements.

Exact declared native event counts, clean measured source, Release build identity, distinct owned PIDs and nonoverlapping measured processes are audited. Failures are retained and stop dependent comparisons.
capture: Optional ordinary-token PresentMon 2.5.1, unique ETW session, owned Player PID, qpc_time and v2_metrics. Attach after process creation; early startup may be missed. Preserve tool hash, arguments, capture PID, target PID, timestamps, errors, exit and actual CSV mapping/coverage. First failure disables subsequent capture, without elevation or statistical retakes. No WPR start or existing-session cancellation.
decision: Examine equal work, event counts, focus/pacing, cadence/record CPU/Present wait distributions and missing engine GPU. Nine processes only diagnose sensitivity: one run per scene-mode cannot establish stable causal effect. No formal promotion or full confirmation unless a safe mechanistic candidate is supported and separately frozen with five independent processes and original gates.
limitations: Latin mode order only partially balances time and cache effects.
Native scopes and Unity timing boundaries differ; none is not whole-engine GPU timing.
PresentMon incurs concurrent ETW overhead and is not assumed free.
Missing or zero FrameTimingManager GPU values remain unavailable.
